funder_detail: ITD Cementation India's underground civil works package: 4.59 km, 4 stations (Tannery Road, Venkateshpura, Arabic College, Nagawara), awarded "November 2019" per source (exact day not stated, as_of set to month start). This is one of at least two underground packages on the Pink Line — a second package (Dairy Circle–Langford Town–MICO Industries, won by Afcons Infrastructure) exists but its exact awarded value was not confirmed in this collection pass, so it is not recorded as a separate figure here.
